ValidationRule.description: Should it be necessary to prevent one from updating a quote, assign the Order Processing Disabled for Maintenance custom permission to the appropriate profile(s) to block changes during the maintenance period.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Account/Quote/Opportunity editing has been temporarily disabled while system changes are being made in support of FY26 Territory Management. The system should be available again on February 9th, 2025 at 4:00 PM PT. Please check back at that time. Thanks!
